title: Men's Welder – If You Can Step Over It, I Can Fill It. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Welder Zip Up Hoodie – If You Can Step Over It, I Can Fill It.
seo.description: A welder zip up hoodie: IF YOU CAN STEP OVER IT, I CAN FILL IT. on the back over a welder beside a sparking steel beam, plus stitched I CAN FILL IT. lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This welder zip up hoodie is for the welder who can close any gap you can step over, zipped on for the shop floor and the drive home after a long shift.

A welder in an orange helmet, apron and gloves stands with his arms crossed beside a steel beam throwing orange sparks, with a gas cart behind him, in orange, steel blue, cream and tan with a worn print texture. IF YOU CAN STEP OVER IT, runs above it in two lines and I CAN FILL IT. below in two larger lines of heavy slab capitals: orange and cream on Black and Navy, rust and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small I CAN over FILL IT. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word WELD is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest I CAN FILL IT. wordmark and left-cuff WELD, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the If You Can Step Over It, I Can Fill It. zip hoodie fit?
The If You Can Step Over It, I Can Fill It. welder zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this welder hoodie warm enough for cold shops?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold shops, early shifts and the drive home after a long weld well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, IF YOU CAN STEP OVER IT, above the welder and I CAN FILL IT. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small I CAN over FILL IT. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and WELD is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The I CAN FILL IT. wordmark on the chest and the WELD cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a welder, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the welder who treats every gap as a challenge. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
